narrative.title: The Cadet's Rotating Drill
narrative.scenario: A trainee runs an n-day conditioning camp built around three stations — endurance, sparring, and tactics — each awarding a daily score. Regulations forbid repeating the same station two days in a row so every skill develops evenly. The coaching staff wants the highest possible total score over the camp, so the scheduler must pick one station per day without back-to-back repeats.
narrative.inputFormat: An integer n and an n x 3 matrix points, where points[i][j] is the score for station j on day i.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the maximum total score over n days with no station chosen on consecutive days.

testCases.explanation: Station 2 on day 0 (5), station 0 on day 1 (3), station 1 on day 2 (3) — total 11.
Station 0 on day 0 (10), then station 1 on day 1 (100) — total 110.

hintLevels: Level 1: Track one value per station — the best total if today ends on that station.
Level 2: today[j] = points[i][j] + max of yesterday's two other stations.
Level 3: The first day seeds the three states directly; the answer is the max of the final day's states.
